reviews.comment:
Los empleados no tienen ganas de trabajar, demoran una eternidad y cuando le pedis que te limpien el vidrio siendo que le vas a pagar por ello hacen una cara de como que le estás pidiendo que te laven el vehículo, lamentablemente deben cambiar la actitud muchachos deja mucho que desear, la shell les da cátedra en atención al cliente

(Translated by Google)
The employees don't seem to want to work, they take forever, and when you ask them to clean your windshield, even though you're going to pay them for it, they look like you're asking them to wash your car. Unfortunately, they really need to change their attitude; it leaves a lot to be desired. Shell is a masterclass in customer service.
